summary: Quantum Corporation filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026, disclosing the appointment of James C. Clancy as Chief Operating Officer effective that date, concurrent with his voluntary resignation from the Board and its Audit and Governance/Nominating committees. Terms include a $400,000 base salary, a 60% target bonus, 150,000 RSUs vesting annually over three years, and 400,000 options vesting monthly over 48 months, plus a standard change-of-control agreement. The appointment is a planned executive addition rather than a forced departure; watch for integration and whether further leadership changes follow.
